finding: BigQuery DML (DELETE/UPDATE/MERGE) is blocked project-wide: real 403 billingNotEnabled, "DML queries are not allowed in the free tier". SELECT and INSERT both work (verified: the 895-series AI.FORECAST INSERT succeeded for real). This blocks: data/bigquery/sense/04_rolldown.sql (contains a DELETE), agents/gate/bigquery_store.py::BigQueryStore.write() (DELETE-then-load, used by every table write), and BigQueryStore.upsert() (MERGE).

evidence.delete_test_job_error: 403 Billing has not been enabled for this project. Enable billing at https://console.cloud.google.com/billing. DML queries are not allowed in the free tier.

classification: project-level billing account setting, not an IAM role gap -- no role grant narrows or fixes this; it needs the billing account owner to enable a paid tier.
impact_on_A3: jobs/sense/run.py and jobs/measure/run.py were wired with a TAAL_BATCH_STORE=bigquery selector (code correct, unit-tested with a fake client, local default behaviour unchanged -- verified). End-to-end execution against real BigQuery with TAAL_BATCH_STORE=bigquery could not be verified beyond the SQL/INSERT layer already proven in A2, because every table write goes through BigQueryStore.write(), which is DELETE-gated.
impact_on_A2: The AI.FORECAST baseline itself (02_forecast_timesfm.sql, INSERT-only) runs and was verified for real at full scale (895 series, 25060 rows). data/bigquery/sense/04_rolldown.sql (node-level rolldown, needed before the Sense job can hand node-level rows to gaps.detect()) could not be verified end-to-end for the same reason -- its DELETE step is blocked.
not_attempted: Enabling billing on amru-509214 was not attempted -- that is a financial/administrative decision for the project owner, not a role grant, and outside what this task authorized.
